metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (batch 3 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-FORKCHOICE-COMPLETE returns accurate DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS reflecting actual chain state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate forkchoiceUpdated response construction in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS population from STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY
3. Verify status reflects actual validation result (VALID/INVALID/SYNCING)
4. Check that latestValidHash is correctly set from processing results
5. Verify payloadId is included when block building was initiated
6. Confirm no path allows status forgery or incorrect mapping
7. Test edge cases: unknown block hash, syncing state, validation failure

executable_checks.assertion: Latest valid hash is set correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-FORKCHOICE-COMPLETE-001 -> EDGE-FORKCHOICE-COMPLETE. Response integrity is critical for CL fork choice decisions. Incorrect status could cause chain splits.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-VALIDATE-STRUCTURE ensures all payloads undergo structural validation before execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate NewPayload entry point in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace execution path to ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE
3. Verify block hash computation and comparison against declared hash
4. Check parent hash existence validation
5. Verify timestamp ordering (block.timestamp > parent.timestamp)
6. Confirm transaction root Merkle verification
7. Ensure no path bypasses structural validation to reach execution
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-VALIDATE-STRUCTURE-001 -> EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-VALIDATE-STRUCTURE. First line of defense against malformed payloads. Block hash verification is cryptographic guarantee.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID routes structurally invalid payloads to rejection without execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate structural validation in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Identify all error conditions that trigger EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID
3. Verify INVALID_BLOCK_HASH status is returned for hash mismatch
4. Check that invalid payloads cannot proceed to transaction execution
5. Verify no state modifications occur for rejected payloads
6. Confirm STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-INVALID-STRUCTURE is reached
7. Test: malformed payload with incorrect block hash

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid block hash error status defined

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID-001 -> EDGE-STRUCTURE-INVALID. Error handling path must prevent invalid payloads from consuming resources or modifying state.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-STRUCTURE-VALID only traverses after all structural checks pass
detection_procedure: 1. Locate condition for proceeding past structural validation
2. Verify all required checks are performed before this edge:
a. Block hash matches computed hash
b. Parent block exists in local chain
c. Timestamp > parent timestamp
d. Transaction root verification
3. Confirm no partial validation allows traversal
4. Check for race conditions in validation logic
5. Verify DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD integrity is verified
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-STRUCTURE-VALID-001 -> EDGE-STRUCTURE-VALID. Parent existence, timestamp ordering, and block hash integrity are verified before this edge is taken.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-CONVERT-INSERT maintains data integrity during payload-to-block conversion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ExecutableDataToBlock in beacon/engine/types.go
2. Verify lossless conversion from ExecutableData to Block
3. Check that block hash after conversion matches original payload hash
4. Verify all fields are correctly mapped:
a. Transactions, withdrawals, parent hash, state root
b. Gas limit, gas used, timestamp, extra data
c. Base fee, blob gas fields for Cancun+
5. Confirm no data truncation or modification during conversion
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-CONVERT-INSERT-001 -> EDGE-CONVERT-INSERT. Conversion is deterministic. Block hash must match pre-validated payload hash for integrity.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-INSERT-PROCESS ensures blocks are stored before transaction processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate InsertBlockWithoutSetHead in core/blockchain.go
2. Verify block is written to database before processing begins
3. Confirm non-canonical insertion does not set chain head
4. Check that block body and header are persisted
5. Verify processing failure does not corrupt stored block
6. Ensure stored block can be retrieved after insertion
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-INSERT-PROCESS-001 -> EDGE-INSERT-PROCESS. Block persistence before processing prevents data loss on failure. Non-canonical insertion preserves chain integrity.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-VALID only traverses when transactions succeed AND state root matches
detection_procedure: 1. Locate state processor in core/state_processor.go Process()
2. Trace validation logic after transaction execution
3. Verify state root comparison: computed vs declared
4. Confirm all transactions must execute successfully
5. Check gas used validation against header
6. Verify receipts root comparison
7. Ensure any mismatch routes to EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-BLOCK-VALID-001 -> EDGE-BLOCK-VALID. Merkle Patricia Trie state root is cryptographic guarantee of correct execution. Both transaction success and state match required.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC correctly routes failed blocks and rolls back state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate error handling in state processor
2. Verify state changes are discarded on failure
3. Check that transactional state is used during processing
4. Confirm database is not modified for invalid blocks
5. Verify correct routing to STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID
6. Check for partial commit vulnerabilities
7. Test: block with invalid transaction, verify clean rollback
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC-001 -> EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC. Block processing uses transactional state. All changes discarded on this path. No partial corruption possible.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND sets VALID status after successful state commitment
detection_procedure: 1. Trace path from ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE to response construction
2. Verify PayloadStatus is set to VALID on this path
3. Confirm latestValidHash is set to the committed block hash
4. Verify no error conditions on this path can alter status
5. Check for race conditions between commit and response
6. Ensure VALID is only returned after actual commit completes
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND-001 -> EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND. Response latestValidHash must match committed block. VALID status enables CL to update fork choice.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND correctly reports INVALID status with latestValidHash for chain recovery
detection_procedure: 1. Trace path from STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID to response construction
2. Verify PayloadStatus is set to INVALID on this path
3. Confirm latestValidHash points to last known valid ancestor
4. Check that validation error details are preserved
5. Verify no path from invalid state can produce VALID response
6. Ensure response enables CL to identify fork point

executable_checks.assertion: Latest valid hash computation for invalid blocks

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND-001 -> EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND. latestValidHash helps CL identify the fork point for chain recovery. Critical for handling invalid chain segments.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-COMPLETE returns accurate DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS for consensus decisions
detection_procedure: 1. Locate newPayload response construction in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify all possible status values are correctly set:
a. VALID - block validated and committed
b. INVALID - validation failed
c. SYNCING - parent block not available
d. ACCEPTED - block valid but not fully validated
3. Confirm status matches actual processing outcome
4. Verify response returns to STATE-EL-IDLE
5. Check for any response corruption paths
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-COMPLETE-001 -> EDGE-NEWPAYLOAD-COMPLETE. Consensus safety depends on accurate EL responses. Incorrect status could cause chain splits or stalls.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETURNED-IDLE returns system to idle state and releases resources
detection_procedure: 1. Trace getPayload completion path to STATE-EL-IDLE
2. Verify payload build resources are released
3. Check that payload ID is invalidated after retrieval
4. Confirm no memory leaks in payload building process
5. Verify concurrent getPayload requests are handled correctly
6. Check timeout handling for unretrieved payloads
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETURNED-IDLE-001 -> EDGE-PAYLOAD-RETURNED-IDLE. Clean state transition prevents resource exhaustion. Build session must be properly terminated.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-TX-VALID only traverses after complete transaction validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate validateTx in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go
2. Verify all validation checks before this edge:
a. Signature verification (secp256k1)
b. Nonce check against pending state
c. Balance >= gasLimit * gasPrice + value
d. Gas limit >= intrinsic gas
e. Format-specific validation per tx type
3. Confirm only passing transactions reach STATE-TX-PENDING
4. Check for any bypass paths to pending pool
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-TX-VALID-001 -> EDGE-TX-VALID. secp256k1 signature verification is cryptographic guarantee. All validation steps mandatory before pool entry.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-TX-INVALID routes all failing transactions to rejection
detection_procedure: 1. Locate all error return paths in validateTx()
2. Verify each validation failure leads to rejection
3. Confirm rejected transactions cannot enter pool
4. Check error message does not leak sensitive info
5. Verify no partial state modification on rejection
6. Ensure all transaction types have proper error paths
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-EDGE-TX-INVALID-001 -> EDGE-TX-INVALID. All validation failures must route here. Error returned to submitter without affecting system state.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-BLOCK-RECEIVED only contains structurally validated blocks
detection_procedure: 1. Trace entry to GRAPH-BLOCK-PROCESSING sub-graph
2. Verify entry is only from ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK in main graph
3. Confirm prior structural validation has occurred
4. Check block header integrity at this state
5. Verify block body is complete with all transactions
6. Ensure no invalid blocks can reach this state
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-STATE-BLOCK-RECEIVED-001 -> STATE-BLOCK-RECEIVED. Entry point for block processing sub-graph. Prior structural validation is mandatory.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-INIT-PROCESSING correctly initializes fresh context for block processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block processing initialization in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify fresh receipts array is created
3. Check gas pool initialization to block gas limit
4. Verify EVM context is created fresh for each block
5. Confirm no stale data from previous blocks persists
6. Check for proper state snapshot creation
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-ACTION-INIT-PROCESSING-001 -> ACTION-INIT-PROCESSING. Fresh context ensures isolation between block processing sessions. Gas pool set to block gas limit.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-APPLY-HARD-FORKS applies fork-specific state mutations correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ApplyDAOHardFork and similar in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify chain config determines which forks apply
3. Check fork activation based on block number/timestamp
4. Verify DAO fork irregular state transfer if applicable
5. Confirm fork mutations occur before transaction processing
6. Test: block at fork boundary, verify correct rules applied
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-ACTION-APPLY-HARD-FORKS-001 -> ACTION-APPLY-HARD-FORKS. Fork rules are deterministic based on block height. Chain config controls activation.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-PROCESS-BEACON-ROOT (EIP-4788) correctly stores beacon block root
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ProcessBeaconBlockRoot in core/state_processor.go or consensus/beacon/
2. Verify system call to BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS contract
3. Check beacon root is stored with correct timestamp key
4. Verify ring buffer storage mechanism (8191 slots)
5. Confirm execution occurs before user transactions
6. Check Cancun+ activation requirement
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-ACTION-PROCESS-BEACON-ROOT-001 -> ACTION-PROCESS-BEACON-ROOT. EIP-4788 enables trustless cross-layer communication. Beacon root is Merkle root from CL.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-PROCESS-PARENT-HASH (EIP-2935) correctly stores parent block hash
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ProcessParentBlockHash in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify system call to HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS contract
3. Check ring buffer storage (8191 blocks history)
4. Verify parent hash is correctly retrieved from header
5. Confirm execution occurs before user transactions
6. Check Prague+ activation requirement
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-ACTION-PROCESS-PARENT-HASH-001 -> ACTION-PROCESS-PARENT-HASH. EIP-2935 extends BLOCKHASH beyond 256 blocks. Block hash is cryptographic commitment.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ITERATING-TXS processes transactions in order with proper isolation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transaction iteration in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify transactions are processed in block order (index 0, 1, 2...)
3. Check each transaction gets fresh EVM context
4. Verify state is shared between transactions within block
5. Confirm gas pool is correctly decremented per transaction
6. Check for any parallel execution that breaks ordering
checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-BP-NODE-STATE-ITERATING-TXS-001 -> STATE-ITERATING-TXS. Deterministic transaction ordering ensures consensus. Each node must produce identical state.
